summary: Verified MOD Staffing fixes end-to-end via /modservice login as test@army.mod.test. Both reported bugs are fixed. No flicker on Staff tab; Handover Diary is present and functional. Staff & Transfers regression pass.
critical_code_review_comments: StaffingConsole.js line 194 guard `if (tab === 'staff' && !leafToGroup.staff) setTab('hr')` correctly breaks the previous staff<->hr ping-pong for MOD tenants (which have 'staff' as a valid leaf).
MOD groups (line 141-146) correctly include Staff, Transfers, and Handover Diary (leaf id 'comms' → renders <CommsTab/>).
Initial state migration (line 183) `if (saved === 'staff' && !isMOD) return 'hr'` correctly no-ops for MOD tenants.
test_credentials: MOD site user: test@army.mod.test / Test123! (via /modservice, first click 'Accept All' cookie banner). Login succeeded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: /modservice → click 'Accept All' cookie banner → fill 2 inputs by index (input[0]=email/site code, input[1]=password; the email input has no type='email' so use nth-based selector) → click 'SIGN IN'. Lands on /modservice operator dashboard (URL stays /modservice, not /pulse). Click 'Staffing' pill to open the MOD staffing area. Tabs data-testids: staffing-tab-staff, staffing-tab-mod-transfer, staffing-tab-comms (Handover Diary).
